required_readiness_items.name: payment/access confirmed
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: paid pilot access state is confirmed before operation
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: payment is missing, ambiguous, disputed, or treated as engine authority

required_readiness_items.name: coach account active
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: coach account is invited-only, inactive, missing, or inferred

required_readiness_items.name: athlete account active
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: athlete account is invited-only, inactive, missing, or inferred

required_readiness_items.name: coach-athlete link accepted
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: link status is accepted and not revoked, rejected, expired, or inferred
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: link is missing, pending, revoked, rejected, expired, or inferred

required_readiness_items.name: scope locked
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: pilot scope is locked to supported actor, execution scope, activity, and phase boundary
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: scope is missing, broad, org/team/gym-based, or undefined

required_readiness_items.name: Phase 1 accepted
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: current accepted immutable version-pinned Phase 1 declaration exists
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: Phase 1 declaration is missing, unaccepted, superseded, mutable, mismatched, or inferred

required_readiness_items.name: first compile admitted
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: compile admission passes only after accepted Phase 1 and valid scope/link preconditions
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: compile is admitted without required preconditions

required_readiness_items.name: first executable session exists
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: first executable session exists and is tied to lawful compile output
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: session is missing, unbound, generated outside v0, or proof-layer dependent

required_readiness_items.name: session can be executed factually
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: start, work event, and terminal/factual state path are available
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: execution requires coaching judgement, readiness, safety, optimisation, or messaging

required_readiness_items.name: split/return works if included
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: included split/return behaviour is factual and deterministic, or excluded and not claimed
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: split/return is claimed without tested path

required_readiness_items.name: partial completion works if included
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: included partial completion records factual amount without altering planned truth, or excluded and not claimed
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: partial completion changes engine legality or future decisions

required_readiness_items.name: coach can view factual artefact
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: coach can view factual execution artefact for linked athlete
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: coach sees unlinked athlete, aggregate org data, evidence, export, or advisory data

required_readiness_items.name: coach can write non-binding note
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: coach note is stored or displayed as non-binding comment only
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: note changes engine truth, legality, substitution, progression, or runtime state

required_readiness_items.name: history counts show factual data only
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: history shows counts or factual summaries only
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: history includes scoring, ranking, analytics, readiness, safety, or optimisation

required_readiness_items.name: support boundaries exist
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: support copy refuses out-of-scope asks safely and factually
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: support implies future delivery, hidden capability, or unsupported operation

required_readiness_items.name: sales/public claims are guarded
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: public claims are exact-match, proof-linked, and fail closed
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: claims mention outcome, safety, readiness, optimisation, evidence, org runtime, or coach override

required_readiness_items.name: no illegal v0 surface exposed
required_readiness_items.pass_condition: every excluded surface has a negative check and no exposed route/copy/surface contradicts v0
required_readiness_items.fail_condition: any forbidden surface is reachable, claimed, or treated as current v0

negative_boundary_checklist.negative_check: No Phase 7 route, UI, acceptance requirement, pilot claim, or operator step is required for Coach Ready.
No Phase 8 route, UI, acceptance requirement, pilot claim, or operator step is required for Coach Ready.
No evidence envelope is required, generated, exported, or claimed as part of v0 Coach Ready.
No proof export, audit export, or downloadable proof artefact is required or claimed.
No organisation-managed execution surface is exposed as current v0.
No team-managed execution surface is exposed as current v0.
No gym/facility runtime surface is exposed as current v0.
No analytics, ranking, trend dashboard, or outcome dashboard is claimed as current v0 capability.
No coach-athlete messaging surface is required or claimed.
No readiness score, readiness state, return-to-play judgement, or competition-ready claim is present.
No medical, injury-prevention, safer-training, rehabilitation, or risk-reduction claim is present.
No optimisation, performance improvement, auto-progression, or best-plan claim is present.
Coach cannot override engine decisions, legality, Phase 1 declarations, substitutions, progression, registries, or runtime truth.

operator_signoff_flow.name: confirm_source_artefacts
operator_signoff_flow.rule: every required readiness item must have at least one source artefact

final_status_meaning.coach_ready: Paid coach pilot can be operated inside v0 boundaries only.
final_status_meaning.blocked: One or more readiness or negative boundary checks failed.
